field_principles.fr11_nonforgetting_stress_ready: Stress result must be complete before capstone.
field_principles.fr11_self_learning_promotable: FR-11 promotion must be explicit and machine-readable.
field_principles.heldout_delta_after_update: New feedback must improve held-out behavior.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Cached-feedback experiments must not claim live LLM inference.
field_principles.kan_locality_probe_available: KAN claims require actual local-probe evidence.
field_principles.no_feedback_delta: Update effect must be separated from replay noise.
field_principles.prior_retention_delta: Continuous learning must not erase prior skills.
field_principles.shuffled_control_delta: Gains must not come from label leakage.
